paymentFollowup.label: Payment Follow-up
paymentFollowup.description: Automatically remind customers to send bill after QR is generated but not paid.
paymentFollowup.enableExplain: When enabled: after you send a QR code, if the customer hasn't paid after X minutes, the bot will automatically send a reminder message. Messages are AI-generated based on chat context.
paymentFollowup.disableExplain: When disabled: the bot will no longer automatically remind customers to pay. You need to monitor and remind manually.

appointmentReminder.label: Appointment Reminder
appointmentReminder.description: Send automatic reminders before the scheduled appointment time.
appointmentReminder.enableExplain: When enabled: X minutes before the appointment, the bot will automatically message the customer. Helps reduce no-show rates.
appointmentReminder.disableExplain: When disabled: the bot will not remind about appointments. Customers might forget and not show up on time.

leadReactivation.label: Lead Reactivation
leadReactivation.description: Automatically re-engage customers who haven't responded for a long time.
leadReactivation.enableExplain: When enabled: if a conversation is silent for more than X hours, the bot will automatically send a follow-up or introduce suitable products. Helps win back potential leads.
leadReactivation.disableExplain: When disabled: the bot will not proactively contact silent customers. You need to decide when to re-engage manually.

integrations.description: Channel connection hub: Zalo / Facebook / Shopee use OAuth (browser login at the provider, then return to VClaw with tokens saved).

integrationPanel.title: Connection status
integrationPanel.hint: Zalo / Facebook / Shopee: click OAuth → sign in on the provider → you are sent back to VClaw; tokens are stored securely on the server. Telegram: manual flag only.
integrationPanel.oauthUnavailable: If OAuth fails: set ZALO_OA_APP_ID and ZALO_OA_APP_SECRET on the server.
integrationPanel.oauthMetaUnavailable: Requires META_APP_ID and META_APP_SECRET; redirect URI must match Meta Developer Console (META_REDIRECT_URI or default /api/auth/channel/meta/callback).
integrationPanel.oauthShopeeUnavailable: Requires SHOPEE_PARTNER_ID and SHOPEE_PARTNER_KEY; register redirect on Shopee Open Platform (SHOPEE_REDIRECT_URI or default callback). Set SHOPEE_USE_TEST=1 for sandbox.
integrationPanel.pilotNoOAuth: Telegram: no in-app OAuth yet — mark when your bot or server is wired.
integrationPanel.shippingApisBody: GHN: configure via environment variables (GHN_TOKEN, GHN_SHOP_ID).
integrationPanel.envHintBody: Zalo OA: ZALO_OA_APP_ID, ZALO_OA_APP_SECRET, ZALO_OA_REDIRECT_URI (or default callback). Facebook: META_APP_ID, META_APP_SECRET, META_REDIRECT_URI. Shopee: SHOPEE_PARTNER_ID, SHOPEE_PARTNER_KEY, SHOPEE_REDIRECT_URI; SHOPEE_USE_TEST=1 for sandbox. Zalo webhook: URL shown under the Zalo card.

oauthFlash.zalo_oauth_ok: Zalo OA connected — token saved on the server.
oauthFlash.meta_oauth_ok: Facebook connected — token saved; Messenger webhook is a separate later step.
oauthFlash.meta_oauth_err: Facebook returned an error — try again or check Meta Developer settings.
oauthFlash.meta_oauth_bad_state: Invalid Facebook OAuth session — try signing in again.
oauthFlash.meta_oauth_exchange_fail: Facebook code exchange failed — check META_APP_SECRET and redirect URI.
oauthFlash.shopee_oauth_bad: Invalid Shopee OAuth parameters — try authorizing again.
oauthFlash.shopee_oauth_fail: Shopee authorization failed — check partner id/key and registered redirect.

paymentAutoApprove.disableExplain: When disabled: even if the bill matches, the status won't change automatically. Bot only asks customer to wait for shop check, admin must approve manually.

automationEnabled.label: Enable Automation
automationEnabled.description: Allow Zalo bot to auto-reply, create orders, follow-up, and run heartbeat/marketing.
automationEnabled.enableExplain: When enabled: OpenClaw receives prompt enrich from VClaw, bot can reply to customers and follow-up/marketing jobs are allowed to send messages.
automationEnabled.disableExplain: When disabled: enrich endpoint returns skipAutoReply to OpenClaw; heartbeat and marketing won't send auto-messages.

replies.nav: Opened the matching page. Finish the action (add / save / change status) on the form.

replies.navIntegrations: Opened **Integrations**. The pilot only **saves** channel connection state; there is **no** “post for me” button yet. Post on Zalo/Facebook directly, or use **Reports** → SKU export when needed.

navSteps.default: If you want, I can guide the exact button flow on this screen.
navSteps.guide: Check the “Suggested flow” section to go from consultation to order closing in five steps.
navSteps.products: On this screen, click **Add New Product** and fill name + price first for a quick catalog.
navSteps.orders: Click **Add Order**, choose customer and amount, then update status to track closing progress.
navSteps.payments: Review pending payments, verify proof, then update status to avoid missing transfers.
navSteps.customers: Click **Add customer** and save phone number so follow-up is easier after consultation.
navSteps.bookings: Pick date and time, then confirm booking to lock the slot while the customer is active.
navSteps.shipping: Add shipping notes on each order so operations can dispatch faster.
navSteps.settings: Confirm shop name and payment QR first so nothing is wrong when sending to customers.
navSteps.inbox: Start with the newest inbox task to avoid dropping hot leads.
navSteps.automation: Create short follow-up jobs and keep them pending approval before outbound actions.
navSteps.zalouser: Start Zalo sign-in, scan QR, then select the right chat before replying.
navSteps.reports: Use revenue, open orders, and pending payments to set today's sales priorities.
